static_features: A lone warrior with a scarred physical appearance, betraying years of fighting experience.
dynamic_features: Draped in a heavy, tattered black synthetic cloak scarred by plasma burns and grime. Wielding the Luminar, an ancient data-blade whose crystalline structure ignites with violent, cool sapphire energy. Wears gloves.

static_features: A figure of profound darkness with a faceless presence. Their silhouette is unnervingly absolute, seemingly absorbing all light.
dynamic_features: Draped in heavy, layered, traditional-looking robes that absorb weak neon light. Two pinpricks of pure, cold white data briefly bloom deep within their hood.
